summary: Verification pass for the fixes captured in iteration_12.json + smoke of the NEW advanced dashboard. Login demo@timologio.gr / demo1234 works and now uses method='post' (verified: form attribute + no 'password=' in URL after submit). The new dashboard renders all requested widgets (data-testid=action-center, action-center-count=10, vat-position-card, aging-card, top-customers-card, subscriptions-card) with sensible numbers and the previously reported overdue definition, credit-note sign, IA rename, sidebar labels, banking genitive months, POS 'Οθόνη αφής', /reports emoji + ISO dates, /billing wording, portal 'Σελίδα πελάτη' + 'ηλεκτρονική πληρωμή', Settings 'Εξαγωγή δεδομένων' tab and Greek tab labels ('Αναζήτηση ΑΦΜ (ΑΑΔΕ)', 'Ηλ. αλληλογραφία', 'Διασυνδέσεις & API'), /invoices/new mobile overflow (all fixed). BUT two audit items are NOT fixed and one NEW inconsistency was discovered in the new dashboard: (1) /copilot still shows 'Powered by Claude Sonnet 5' (untranslated + fake model). (2) /customers list still uses '—' in 5 numeric cells (mixed with '0,00 €' in 9 others) — inconsistency remains. (3) NEW BUG: Dashboard KPI 'Ανεξόφλητα (σύνολο) = 2.430,40 €' contradicts the aging-card just below on the same page which shows 'σύνολο 17.656,08 €' and matches /reports 'Σύνολο ανεξόφλητων 17.656,08 €'. The 'Ανεξόφλητα (σύνολο)' KPI appears to be scoped to a subset (maybe current-month only) despite its explicit '(σύνολο)' label — one of the two must change. Full responsive pass of the new dashboard at 390/768/1280/1920 shows zero horizontal overflow.

The aging-card in the SAME dashboard shows 'σύνολο 17.656,08 €' and /reports 'Ενηλικίωση απαιτήσεων · Σύνολο ανεξόφλητων 17.656,08 €' — a 15.225,68 € gap.
